entities.name: Rus'–Byzantine Treaty of 907
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: According to the Primary Chronicle, the first Rus'–Byzantine Treaty was concluded in 907 as a result of Oleg's raid against Constantinople. Scholars generally consider this document as preliminary to the Rus'–Byzantine Treaty of 911.
